title: Research audit: binary cover order and exact finite invoice guards
body:
The selected #626 finite invoice prices routing and physical rows using the binary **bilinear dot-product isometry group** in dimension 73. This independent audit confirms its exact order and reproduces all nine finite invoice guards, with controls that distinguish the group definition from permissive upper-bound checks.

**Status: research audit / independent finite evidence; no new κ.**

- A written characteristic-vector/symplectic-basis argument is checked against exhaustive ordered orthonormal-basis enumeration in dimensions 1–7 (1,475,337 complete bases). A separate all-matrix enumeration through dimension 4 checks the enumerator.
- Exact integer arithmetic reproduces the 2,628-bit group order, 2,641-bit physical stock, and row coefficient **16,467 < 20,161**. No production verifier or constructor is imported.
- Five wrong-order controls are explicitly rejected. Four smaller factors still pass every upper-bound guard; replacing the group with **GL(73,2)** fails the row guard (**21,867 > 20,161**) while the other eight pass. With other invoice quantities fixed, multiplying the cover by 2^1846 still passes; 2^1847 first fails at strict row equality. These are modified-model controls and a scoped sensitivity result, not defects alleged against the intact construction or a paid alternative cover.

Only `research/orthogonal-cover-invoice-audit/` is added: proof, standalone verifier, exact certificate, tests, source pins, local sprint claim and validation receipt. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/orthogonal-cover-invoice-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/orthogonal-cover-invoice-audit/test_verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_ORTHOGONAL_COVER_INVOICE_AUDIT dimensions=1..7 guards=9 controls=5 kappa=unchanged`, followed by eight passing tests. Validation passed on macOS arm64 / Python 3.14.5, including `-I -B -O`, a minimal relocated checkout in a path with spaces, source/certificate corruption, two implementation mutations, strict row-boundary checks, `make selected-record-check` and staged whitespace checks.

Base: **66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60**. OS assignment seed **65**, adversarial-audit track. Pins bind the selected record, source inventory, #626 assembly, invoice and owner receipts, and reviewed heads #626 `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`, #623, #622 and #543. No pinned coordination issue exists; the claim is local. The final overlap pass covered 586 open PRs through #767. #717 explores distinct moment/invoice sensitivity and program permutations and is credited; no pending contribution supplies inputs here.

All supplier/compiler, owner geometry, common-label/mutable-basis, whole-call hosting, normalized-residual, precision/tape/exact-recovery, bit H1–H5 and analytic assumptions remain inherited. The full supplier replay, repository suite, 47 assembly inequalities, Linux CI and Lean were not rerun. Finite enumeration is not a formal proof of the full multiplication theorem.

Credits include Jeremy Kothe (#622/#623), Chafik Boukhalfa (#626), icekylinx, DreamingOfClouds, Rohan Arun (#559), eumemic (#543), the maintainer review and retained predecessors. Prepared for **Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex** assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human peer review is claimed.
